title: Qualify live independent three-package Standard net11 locked restore and exact version/topology drift refusals
commitMessage: test: qualify live Math Standard locked restore and pin refusals

contribution.summary: Qualify a fresh isolated .NET 11 locked restore for three physically SHA-pinned Math archives with two real negative pin/topology cases, keeping SDK 10 and guidance 0.26.
contribution.value: RS322 succeeded first-pass under DWF 0.1.72 with live SHA-256 checks on exactly three immutable Standard/Expression/Quantities published archives from NUGET_LOCAL and authentic historical RS253/RS254 locked-restore reports. RS323 copies only these pinned archives into an isolated local feed, reuses Math's original Standard ten-check package-only consumer and creates a short-path net11.0/C#15 fixture. Prove one direct and two transitive packages in a stable lock, locked restore, exact loaded DLL hashes and ten mathematical checks. A changed Standard version pin and falsely promoted direct Quantities reference must each fail locked restore and leave the original lock and archives unchanged. Keep GREEN in-progress, ten other libraries unqualified, production SDK 10.0.401/net10.0/C#14, packages and guidance 0.26 untouched.
debtChanges: RS322 succeeded first-pass under executor 0.1.72, qualifying three existing SHA-pinned private archives and the exact RS253/RS254 historical restore lineage.
RS323 tests a new short-path copied-feed Windows net11 restore and original ten-check Standard consumer rather than replaying RS254 or building a second release tool.
Two copied consumer --locked-mode negative cases reject version and direct/transitive drift with byte-identical clean restoration; no original feed mutation.
T2 GREEN remains in-progress, and ten other packages, all-platform parity, migration, publication and held DWF guidance 0.27 upgrades remain unqualified.

RS323 preselection refused before attempt allocation: CS0165, unassigned local graph after a helper-guarded TryGetProperty. Assign it explicitly after checking net11.0; leave the two locked restore refusals and immutable three-archive scope unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: After live three-package locked restore and drift refusals pass, separately assess T2 GREEN closure and admit independent package-risk Verification without claiming net11 migration readiness.
